method: Native macOS window capture using screencapture -x -o -l for the isolated app PID, 2560×1600 pixels. Uniformly resized to 1440×900 using the existing local capture harness. Native transparent corners retained; no app controls or states retouched. Playwright/CDP invokes shipped UI/preload actions, never patches app code.
reproducibility: Layout/seed/fixture content is controlled. Clock, capture time and live website content remain truthful at capture time, not painted over or frozen in the UI.
